name: Naturalisation by Years of Residence

requirements.blocker_text: Requires 7 years of lawful residence within the last 10 years, plus a continuous 12 months immediately before applying (8 years total). Time on a student permit does not count.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 7 years' lawful residence within the last 10, plus 12 continuous months immediately before applying.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires Greek language proficiency at B1, verified by the Greek Language Certification Examinations or University of Cyprus certification.
requirements.fix_path: Pass a B1-level Greek language examination.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires passing an examination on the basic elements of Cyprus's contemporary political and social reality, with a 60% passing mark.
requirements.fix_path: Book and pass the civics examination.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires good character, stable accommodation, financial means, and an intention to reside in Cyprus.
Requires 5 years total as a highly-skilled employee, with Greek proficiency at A2 level.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 5 years' qualifying residence as a highly-skilled employee.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires Greek language proficiency at A2.
requirements.fix_path: Pass an A2-level Greek language examination.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires 4 years total as a highly-skilled employee, with Greek proficiency at B1 level.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 4 years' qualifying residence as a highly-skilled employee.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires Greek language proficiency at B1.
requirements.fix_path: Pass a B1-level Greek language examination.

evidence_required.document: Proof of qualifying years of residence
Greek language certificate (A2 or B1 depending on group)
Proof of stable accommodation and financial means

sources.title: GK Law Firm -- Cyprus Citizenship New Law: 4 and 5 years criteria (amendment of 30 November 2023 to the Civil Registry Law)
